certificationCard.description: The Salesforce Associate Certification is designed for individuals who may have up to 6 months of user experience. It validates foundational knowledge and understanding of the Customer 360 Platform.

keyConcepts.h2: Salesforce Platform Foundations: Key Concepts for the Exam

blocks.heading: Salesforce Platform Architecture
blocks.body: Salesforce is a multi-tenant cloud platform — all customers share the same infrastructure but data is logically isolated. The platform provides automatic upgrades (3 major releases per year: Spring, Summer, Winter), managed scalability, and built-in high availability. The metadata-driven architecture means that customizations (objects, fields, layouts, code) are stored as metadata rather than application code changes. The Lightning Platform delivers Force.com (declarative + code), Experience Cloud (portals), and Einstein (AI) on a common foundation. The Foundations exam tests understanding of the multi-tenant model, what the metadata layer controls, and how Salesforce manages upgrades without breaking customer customizations.

blocks.heading: Data Modeling Basics
blocks.body: Salesforce organizes data into Objects (equivalent to database tables) and Records (rows). Standard Objects (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case) are pre-built. Custom Objects store business-specific data. Fields define the data types stored in an object. **Record Types** allow different **page layouts** and picklist values per user group on the same object. Relationships connect objects: Lookup (loose coupling, optional parent), **Master-Detail** (tight coupling, cascade delete, **roll-up summary**). External Objects connect to external data via Salesforce Connect. The exam tests field type selection (Formula, Roll-Up Summary, Picklist, Text, Currency), when to use Lookup vs. Master-Detail, and how Record Types enable different business processes on the same object.

blocks.heading: Security Model Overview
blocks.body: Salesforce security operates at four levels: Org (login, network access), Object (CRUD via profiles/**permission sets**), Field (read/edit via profiles/permission sets), and Record (**OWD** + **Role Hierarchy** + Sharing). Profiles assign baseline permissions to every user of a type. Permission Sets grant additional permissions to specific users without changing the profile. **Permission Set Groups** bundle multiple Permission Sets. Org-Wide Defaults (OWD) set the most restrictive baseline access for records. Role Hierarchy and **Sharing Rules** extend record visibility beyond OWD. The exam tests which security layer to modify to solve a given access problem — know that you always configure the most restrictive layer first, then open up selectively.

blocks.heading: Automation Overview: Declarative Tools
blocks.body: Salesforce provides a suite of declarative automation tools. **Validation Rules** prevent records from being saved if data doesn't meet criteria — fires before save. Formula Fields calculate values automatically from other field values — read-only. Default Field Values pre-fill fields on new records. Record-Triggered Flows execute automation before or after a record save — replaces Process Builder and Workflow Rules. Approval Processes route records through human reviewers. Scheduled Flows process batches of records at a scheduled time. The Foundations exam tests which tool to use for: enforcing data quality (Validation Rule), calculating a derived value (Formula Field), automating a multi-step process (Flow), or requiring manager sign-off (Approval Process).

blocks.heading: AppExchange, Ecosystem & Trailhead
blocks.body: **AppExchange** is Salesforce's marketplace for third-party applications, components, Flows, and Lightning Bolts. Managed Packages are ISV-published solutions that are upgradeable and have protected code. Unmanaged Packages are open-source and not upgradeable. Security Review ensures AppExchange listings meet Salesforce security standards. Partner Ecosystem includes consulting SIs, ISVs, and Salesforce-trained professionals (Trailblazers). **Trailhead** is the free learning platform — modules, trails, superbadges, and certifications. Trailblazer Community provides forums and user groups. The Foundations exam tests the difference between managed and unmanaged packages, how to evaluate an AppExchange listing, and the role of the Salesforce ecosystem in extending the platform.

scenarioTips.h2: How to Pass the Salesforce Platform App Builder Foundations Exam
scenarioTips.intro: This associate-level exam tests foundational knowledge of the Salesforce platform. Questions focus on what Salesforce can do, how core features work together, and basic configuration — ideal for those new to the ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Understand the Core Data Model
blocks.body: Know standard vs. custom objects, field types, and relationship types (lookup vs. **master-detail**). Understand how the App Builder uses these building blocks to create business applications.

blocks.heading: Core Automation Features
blocks.body: Know Flow Builder for automation, **validation rules** for data quality, formula fields for calculated values, and approval processes for multi-step reviews. No deep configuration details required — focus on use cases.

blocks.heading: User Management Basics
blocks.body: Profiles control what users can do; Roles control what data they can see via the **role hierarchy**. **Permission Sets** add access beyond a profile. These three work together to govern user access.

blocks.heading: Reports & Dashboards Overview
blocks.body: Know that reports query Salesforce data and dashboards visualize report data. Understand the four report types at a high level and that dashboards require a running user for data access.

blocks.heading: The Salesforce Ecosystem
blocks.body: Understand **AppExchange** for third-party apps, **Trailhead** for learning, and the main Salesforce clouds (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, Platform) at a high level — what each cloud solves and when it's appropriate.

sampleQuestions.question: Who is the Salesforce Associate certification designed for?
options: Individuals with up to 6 months of user experience on Salesforce
sampleQuestions.explanation: The Associate certification is designed for individuals who may have up to 6 months of user experience.

sampleQuestions.question: What does the Customer 360 Platform refer to?
options: The integrated set of Salesforce products that connect customer data across the organization
sampleQuestions.explanation: Customer 360 is Salesforce's integrated platform connecting customer data across products.

sampleQuestions.question: Which object is central to the Salesforce CRM data model?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Account is a core object representing companies or people you do business with.

sampleQuestions.question: What is a Record in Salesforce?
options: A single row of data in an object (e.g., one Account)
sampleQuestions.explanation: A record is a single row of data in an object.

sampleQuestions.question: Which feature allows users to see their tasks and calendar?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The Home page and Activity components show tasks and calendar.

sampleQuestions.question: What is a Dashboard in Salesforce?
options: A collection of report components displayed together for at-a-glance visibility
sampleQuestions.explanation: Dashboards display multiple report charts and metrics in a single view.

sampleQuestions.question: Which Salesforce feature enables real-time collaboration on records?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Chatter and Activity enable comments, mentions, and collaboration on records.

sampleQuestions.question: What does the Lightning Experience refer to?
options: The modern Salesforce user interface with responsive design and enhanced features
sampleQuestions.explanation: Lightning Experience is the modern, responsive Salesforce UI.

sampleQuestions.question: Which object typically represents a person or company you do business with?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Account represents companies or people you do business with.

sampleQuestions.question: What is a List View in Salesforce?
options: A filtered list of records from an object displayed in a table format
sampleQuestions.explanation: List views show filtered records in a tabular layout for quick access.

sampleQuestions.question: Which navigation element helps users find records and apps in Salesforce?
sampleQuestions.explanation: App Launcher and global search help users navigate and find content.

sampleQuestions.question: What does the Customer 360 Platform aim to achieve?
options: A single, unified view of the customer across all touchpoints and systems
sampleQuestions.explanation: Customer 360 unifies customer data across sales, service, marketing, and more.

sampleQuestions.question: Which feature allows users to access Salesforce on mobile devices?
sampleQuestions.explanation: The Salesforce Mobile App provides full CRM access on phones and tablets.

sampleQuestions.question: What is the purpose of Reports in Salesforce?
options: To organize, filter, and display data from your Salesforce records
sampleQuestions.explanation: Reports query and display data from your org's objects and records.

sampleQuestions.question: Which Salesforce concept represents a potential sale?
sampleQuestions.explanation: Opportunity represents a potential sale or deal being pursued.
